options: Dead leaves and bodies would pile up and nutrients would not return to the soil

questions.prompt: Why are producers always at the start of a food chain?
options: They capture energy from sunlight and make food for everything else
questions.explain: All energy in most ecosystems comes from the Sun through producers.

questions.prompt: In the Pond Ecosystem Builder, which pair were both decomposers?
A pond gets covered in thick floating weeds that block the sunlight. Predict what happens to the algae and the fish, and explain why.
questions.modelAnswer: The algae below the weeds can't get sunlight, so they photosynthesise less and die back. Less algae means less food and less oxygen for animals that depend on them, so small animals and then fish decline. When dead algae decompose, decomposers use up even more oxygen, and fish may die. One change in an abiotic factor (light) affects the whole ecosystem.
rubric: Less light → less photosynthesis by algae
Food and oxygen effects on animals and fish
questions.explain: Criterion C: predict and explain effects.
